title: 'Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishou ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase desu' Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kennoji and R_ringo 's Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishou ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase desu ( My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! ) manga unveiled the main cast and a teaser promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Animator Kenichirou Katsura Dies at 59
content: Kenichirou Katsura , known for his character designs for Macross 7 and Knight's & Magic , died on September 30. He was 59. A funeral service was held by his close relatives. title: The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter Releases Visual, Trailer and Staff Details
content: Kadokawa has revealed a visual, a trailer, and production details for the upcoming anime The Skull Dragon’s Precious Daughter ( Hone Dragon no Manamusume ). Kana Hanazawa and Kazuhiko Inoue will star as Eve and Nemu, the Skull Dragon. Doga Kobo ( Asteroid in Love , Oshi no Ko ) animates the adaptation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Anime's 1st Teaser Previews Voice Cast
content: Crunchyroll unveiled a new teaser trailer for the television anime of Kashiko Amane 's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret ( Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ) manga on Thursday. The teaser shows the first footage of the anime and previews the voice cast. The anime's official website also streamed the teaser.
author: ANN

title: Now That We Draw Reveals Opening Song
content: The production committee behind Now That We Draw has revealed the opening song for the upcoming ecchi rom-com. Shallm will perform “Kimiiro Hirari.” The band debuted the song during a performance on their ANTI AFTER SCHOOL EP tour.
author: Anime Corner

title: Magical Buffs Anime's Trailer Unveils More Cast, LiSA's Opening Song, Early Netflix Streaming, January 4 TV Debut
content: Crunchyroll presented a new trailer and key visual for the television anime of Haka Tokura 's Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! light novel serie at New York Comic Con on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'Ghost of Tsushima Kuroudo Kitan' Announces Additional Cast, Staff, 2028 Delay
content: The Crunchyroll showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 revealed additional cast and staff for the anime adaptation of Sucker Punch Productions' Ghost of Tsushima video game on Thursday. The anime has been delayed to 2028 from its originally planned 2027 premiere.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Teenage Mercenary' Reveals Main Staff, 2027 Debut
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con 2026 revealed the main staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promo for the television anime adaptation of YC 's Teenage Mercenary webtoon on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
